description: A repo-native visual design workspace with auto layout, components, and live JSON sync.

tools.name: get_design_metadata
tools.description: Read the active repository design's file, page, canvas, selection, and compact layer index.

tools.name: get_design_context
tools.description: Read the complete active CodeShell Design v3 document, or one node subtree by stable node id.

node_id.description: Optional stable node id. Omit to return the full repository document.

tools.name: use_design
tools.description: Apply a transaction of create_node, update_node, delete_node, move_node, or set_document operations and refresh the live canvas.

save.description: Save to the active repo file after applying. Defaults to true.

tools.name: validate_design
tools.description: Validate the active v3 source model and return deterministic accessibility and layout audit issues.

tools.name: save_design
tools.description: Save the current live canvas to its active .codesign.json repository source.
